verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents automatic TOTP sync: once Authenticator is connected to Password Manager, the Bitwarden apps stay synchronized with any codes you add or edit, and the vault's integrated authenticator generates the TOTP codes. The evidence does not explicitly show the same tokens available at once on a phone, a tablet and a computer, and the cross-app passkey autofill evidence covers passkeys rather than TOTP tokens, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of simultaneous multi-device TOTP availability across phone, tablet and desktop; detail on how sync behaves across devices; independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-device token sync.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically

citations.quote: Once activated, the Bitwarden apps stay synchronized with any codes you add or edit
it automatically produces the time-based one-time passwords (TOTPs)
